items.title: Sir Gerald's Super Sandwich Adventure
items.text: One [[afternoon]], a very [[fearless]] [[sandwich]] named Sir Gerald hopped out of his [[apartment]] to visit his best [[partner]], a grumpy pirate pig. On the way, he hopped through a [[garden]] where a [[sheriff]] of bees was buzzing a [[smooth]] tune. Sir Gerald tripped over a giant [[seashell]] and landed in a [[compartment]] of a shopping cart. A [[spectator]] in a top hat clapped and shouted, “Encore!” The pig was so happy that he gave Sir Gerald a [[pendant]] and built him a tiny [[igloo]] out of pudding. Sir Gerald was not [[dependent]] on anyone, but he did need one [[quarter]] of a hug to feel better!
